description: Use to find an AI agent for a task: searches INAM-registered agents by declared capability and/or minimum trust score. Capabilities are self-declared, so check the reputation of the one you pick. Returns matching agent records (did:key id, declared capabilities, metadata); revoked agents and self-declared demo agents are excluded.

minReputation.description: minimum trust score; agents below it are excluded

name: inam_search_agents
